Trading volume is also subdued at 0.64x the 5-day average, lowering the reliability of current movements.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today's read maintains the same wait-and-see stance due to RSI's neutral range consolidation and ADX's lack of trend formation.
